metadata.case_name: LAU CHI LAM v. CARITAS-HONG KONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Workman II at an elderly home (Caritas)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Early retirement (applied for and approved with effect from 23 September 2008)

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of Lau’s lower back
source: the clinical picture was compatible with soft tissue injury of Lau’s lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: multiple lumbar level degenerative changes with no obvious theca sac or nerve root compression
source: X-ray and MRI done after the accident in 2007 revealed multiple lumbar level degenerative changes with no obvious theca sac or nerve root compression.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: minimal spondylolisthesis over L5/S1; mild degenerative scoliosis
source: There was no spondylosis, minimal spondylolisthesis over L5/S1 and normal lordosis.
Degenerative changes with multiple marginal bone spurs, slightly narrowed L4/5 disc and mild degenerative scoliosis were confirmed.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: unable to walk for a long time or at quick pace
could not return to work or his pre-accident leisure of going fishing

treatments_received: admitted and treated in hospital (initial admission)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could not return to his pre-accident leisure of going fishing.
Unable to return to his pre-accident occupation (Workman II); reduction in work capacity and realistic inability to carry out heavy tasks involving frequent bending and lifting.
Persistent mild residual low back pain arising from soft tissue injury and aggravated pre-existing degeneration.
